youtube_short.title: The $5,000 Childcare Benefit 60% of Parents Miss
title_alternatives: Are You Skipping This $5,000 Tax-Free Parent Benefit?
Open Enrollment Ends Dec 31 — Claim Your $5,000
youtube_short.description: If you have kids under 13, there's a $5,000 tax-free benefit hiding in your open enrollment packet right now — and 60% of eligible parents never click on it. It's called a Dependent Care FSA, and it covers daycare, after-school care, preschool, and even summer day camps. Put in $5,000 pre-tax and you save up to $2,250 depending on your bracket. The deadline is December 31st — miss it and you wait a full year. Check your benefits portal today before it closes. #personalfinance #moneytips #childcare #FSA #openenrollment
